description: Indiana Secretary of State business entity bulk data (INBiz; access review) for the FactLot Registry collector. See docs/registry/sources/in-sos-entities.md.

sources.publisher: Indiana Secretary of State, Business Services Division (INBiz)
sources.gate: Purchase and account. The Secretary's Enhanced Access fee schedule (Regulatory Analysis, LSA Document #25-155, OMB 2025-01R) lists: one-time bulk download $8,000.00 (all registered businesses as of the end of the prior month, delivered on a portable storage device), bulk download with monthly updates $9,500.00, monthly update $500.00, and the Monthly Listing of New Businesses $35.00; the INBiz bulk page says an INBiz account is required to purchase and download. A person must decide whether to buy, create the INBiz account, accept the order terms and pay; none of that was done. Also: inbiz.in.gov answers the collector's robots.txt request with 403 AccessDenied, and the license and AI-use terms of the product are unread.
sources.license: Not read; sold product (order terms unknown)
sources.ai_use: Not addressed on any page read
sources.redistribution: Unknown; the regulatory analysis says bulk data purchases are 'typically ordered for commercial purposes' and that the public can search the same data free online
sources.notes: Fee schedule source: https://www.in.gov/sos/business/files/Regulatory-Analysis-Business-Entity-Bulk-Data-Fees-LSA-25-155-OMB-2025-01R.pdf (read 2026-11-03). The INBiz bulk page is a JavaScript page (11 KB, no text readable by the collector). The free route is the interactive INBiz business search, which is not scraped. in.gov/robots.txt allows all.
